suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific complication outcome risk. Apply only to documented atherosclerotic lower-extremity peripheral artery disease, especially critical limb-threatening ischemia, with separately documented major amputation/loss of use. Do not generalize to venous disease or nonspecific vascular diagnoses. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Peripheral Vascular Disease matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Amputation / Loss of Use of Limbs or Digits with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Apply only to documented atherosclerotic lower-extremity peripheral artery disease, especially critical limb-threatening ischemia, with separately documented major amputation/loss of use. Do not generalize to venous disease or nonspecific vascular diagnoses.
